note: Routing corpus of record (minted 2026-07-07). Positives span imperative / diagnostic / symptom / indirect phrasings of the six catalog-DESIGN axes (definition contract, factory+resolution, two-tier extensibility, naming law, coverage policy, security/conformance). Negatives drawn adversarially from the dangerous near-neighbors: a2ui-protocol (the WIRE shape, the closest — it owns 'why did a payload fail validation / what does a binding look like on the wire'), the a2ui-composer / a2ui-builder / a2ui-reviewer agents (compose / build / grade — MAKING, this pack only answers), a2ui-training-corpus + a2ui-conversational-agent (sibling packs), and the authoring neighborhood (knowledge-author / reference-author / component-author).
